timeOfDay.help: Auto follows your clock; at night the plankton glows. 自動會跟著系統時鐘變化，晚上有螢光浮游生物
items: Auto (system clock) 自動（依系統時間）

shore.help: Press and drag on the sand to write; the next big wave wipes it away. 在沙灘上按住滑鼠拖曳可以在沙上寫字，浪打上來會把字抹掉
items: No beach (open shallows) 沒有沙灘（整片淺海）

waterColor.text: Shallow water colour 淺水顏色

deepColor.text: Deep water colour 深海顏色

newSeabed.text: New seabed 重新產生海床

showSeabed.text: Show the current seabed number 顯示目前海床編號

seabedNumber.text: Fixed seabed number 固定海床編號
seabedNumber.help: Like this seabed? Press “Show” above and type the number that appears top-right in here; it will come back every time. Leave empty for a new one each time. 喜歡現在這片海床？按上面的「顯示」，把右上角出現的數字填進來，以後開機都會是這片。留空＝每次隨機

tide.help: Rises and falls with real time, about every 12.4 hours. 照真實時間大約每 12.4 小時漲退一次

rippleStrength.text: Mouse ripples 滑鼠漣漪強度

rays.help: A blue-spotted stingray rests on the sand; an eagle ray and a manta fly through the water. 藍點魟趴在沙上，斑點鷹魟和鬼蝠魟在水中拍翅膀游

corals.help: Reefs of brain, table, staghorn, boulder and cauliflower corals on the seabed. 海床上長著腦珊瑚、桌形珊瑚、鹿角珊瑚、團塊珊瑚和花椰菜珊瑚

turtle.help: Green, hawksbill and olive ridley turtles swim by from deep water now and then, coming up to breathe. 綠蠵龜、玳瑁和欖蠵龜不時從深水游過來，會浮上水面換氣

dolphins.help: Every few minutes a pod passes through the deep water, coming up to breathe and now and then leaping clear of it. 每隔幾分鐘有一群海豚從深水區游過，會浮上水面換氣，偶爾躍出水面

sharks.help: Now and then a blacktip reef shark, sometimes two, patrols the reef edge; the fish keep well clear of it. 偶爾有一隻（有時兩隻）黑鰭礁鯊沿著珊瑚礁邊緣巡游，魚會遠遠避開

beachLife.text: Hermit crabs & gulls 寄居蟹與海鷗
beachLife.help: Crabs wander the sand leaving footprints and hide when you come close; gulls show only as shadows. 寄居蟹在沙灘上爬、留下腳印，靠近會縮進殼裡；海鷗只看得到影子

hatchlings.help: On some nights a nest hatches on the beach and the little turtles scramble down to the sea. 夜晚偶爾有一窩小海龜在沙灘上孵化，一路爬向大海

feedFish.help: Hold the mouse still on the water to sprinkle food; the fish rush over to eat it. 在水面上按住滑鼠不動就會撒飼料，魚會游過來搶食

floatCount.text: Floating flowers & leaves 漂浮的花與葉

sound.help: Surf in step with the picture. Lively’s own volume setting applies too. 跟畫面同步的浪聲；Lively 的音量設定也會影響

quality.help: Lower it on a slow graphics card or a very large screen: on a 2560×1600 screen 75% looks almost the same and uses about a third less of the graphics card. 顯示卡較弱或螢幕很大時可調低：在 2560×1600 螢幕上 75% 看起來幾乎一樣，顯示卡負擔少約三分之一
items: High (always native resolution) 高（一律原生解析度）

idleSave.text: Save power when idle 閒置時省電
idleSave.help: Drops to 30 FPS after 45 seconds without the mouse, back to full speed as soon as it moves. 滑鼠 45 秒沒動就降到 30 FPS，一動馬上恢復

fps30.text: Limit to 30 FPS 鎖定 30 FPS
fps30.help: Uses less power; otherwise up to 60 FPS. 降低耗電；不勾選時最高 60 FPS
